headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: Gross margin expanded 596bps YoY and 141bps QoQ to 53.81% on a better mix.

EBITDA rose 86.26% YoY to INR 998.60 Mn off a tariff-hit base but fell 6.82% QoQ; EBITDA margin was 8.97%, up 353bps YoY but down 32bps QoQ, as wage hikes and oil- linked costs absorbed part of the gross-margin gain.
PBT rose 164.37% YoY to INR 494.99 Mn (-21.22% QoQ), and PAT jumped 409.97% YoY to INR 412.24 Mn (-6.94% QoQ), aided by a lower 16.72% effective tax rate.

H2 Margin Levers in Place; Q2 Marks the Trough: Hedged USD/INR improves from INR 91 in Q2 to INR 93 in Q3 and INR 94.5–95 in Q4 (worth 130–140bps of EBITDA margin), the 0.5% tariff-related customer discount ends from Q3, and input-cost increases are being passed through.
valuation: Valuation & Outlook: We raise FY27E/FY28E/FY29E revenue by 4.4%/9.9%/9.8% to factor in BTPL consolidation but cut EPS by 5.7%/9.3%/2.4% for higher depreciation, interest and the loss of OCD interest income, partly offset by a lower tax rate.
A two-shift, 1,000-machine Ranchi unit (INR 4 bn revenue potential) starts ramping around Q3FY28, with at least two more 1,000- machine units under evaluation.
BTPL: Q2 revenue was ~INR 1.7 bn with slightly negative EBITDA; captive consumption is 33% and targeted at 50%+ by FY29.
watch: H2 Africa revenue is guided at USD 50– 60 Mn as one weaker customer (20–25% of Africa revenue) is de-risked.

Valuation & Outlook: We raise FY27E/FY28E/FY29E revenue by 4.4%/9.9%/9.8% to factor in BTPL consolidation but cut EPS by 5.7%/9.3%/2.4% for higher depreciation, interest and the loss of OCD interest income, partly offset by a lower tax rate.
